label: Whatever is receiving its esse at a moment is given being then by something
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (correlativity of receiving and giving): in every history of the model, if a principle z is receiving the esse of x at moment t (Receipt.ReceivesAt v z x t, the primitive of definition 506ea036), then something gives x being at t (GivesAt v g x t for some g, definition 158301bc, STRICT esse-giving reading). The giver need not be distinct from x, unique, or a tenseless cause of x's being. Stated over the primitive, which is open between the senses of disambiguation 71d3bdb7: on RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_1 (passion) it holds by definition; on RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_2 (standing composition) it is equivalent to weak concurrent actualization 40a97664. The existential inertialist who accepts the present-tense reading in the standing sense denies it (Control part 2).
